__comment: Terrain-only appearance. IDs 1..7 are packed in mesh vertex alpha as id/16; slice caps add 8 to the tag for quiet detail. Opaque imported art retains alpha=1 and opts out. Colours remain in terrain_blocks and surface_palettes. All widths are world-block units. Hearthblock dressing (doc 256): stone, grass and earth get a one-cell darker edge, a fine seam, ±5% block variation, quiet two-cell flecks and, on about one block in eight, a stepped crack (stone, earth) or a worn patch (grass), all on the 1:16 grid; their old soft seam is replaced by the fine seam. Built logs (doc 275) are drawn as Hearthblock log pieces, not terrain faces, so they take no profile.
